text: ついでに　ここで　カラテ　れんしゅう　していくか！

structure.jp: カラテ　れんしゅう　していくか！
structure.en: how about practising karate before you go!

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb can mean you do something and then go on your way. れんしゅう　していく = 'practise before you go'.

patterns.name: 〜か (inviting)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb, said in a hearty tone, offers an idea rather than really asking. していくか = 'how about doing it before you go?'.
